title: Impl: RX staging ring in C/Zephyr lora_l2_rx.c
description: Replace single rx_stage[255] with a ring of 3 static buffers (3x255B=765B). ISR writes to ring tail via atomic CAS. Work handler drains from ring head. Use atomic head/tail indices. Overflow: drop oldest (overwrite head). File: lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_rx.c. Verify: build compiles on host and cross-compile.
